invariants: Only the authoritative exited-to-finished transition contributes in its own primary SQLite transaction
No sidecar database, per-request journal or permanent dedup runId ledger
Refusal storage is separate from completion storage
No report acceptance retry loop or automatic force is added
limits: Gates exercise the existing service/preparation boundary with isolated ports; authorization-code storage is tested at the refusal hook, not by a live authorized CLI.
Two reconciliation candidates share an SQLite repository and run as scheduled microtasks; cross-process writer contention remains QA 5.4.
Command stats and summary must consume these snapshots/deltas in their respective implementation items; this scaffold does not implement those features.
